heading.en: From the mill to your kitchen

hook.en: Rice milled in Raichur reaches a kirana store in Mangaluru. Between the mill and the shop stands a wholesaler. What does he really do?
hook.kn: ರಾಯಚೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗಿರಣಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಕಿರಾಣಿ ಅಂಗಡಿ ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಗಿರಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ನಡುವೆ ಸಗಟು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಇರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ?

objectives.en: Define internal trade and its types
Explain the services of wholesalers to manufacturers
Explain the services of wholesalers to retailers

narration.en: Rice milled in Raichur reaches a kirana store in Mangaluru. Between the mill and the shop stands a wholesaler. What does he really do?
narration.kn: ರಾಯಚೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗಿರಣಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಮಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಕಿರಾಣಿ ಅಂಗಡಿ ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ. ಗಿರಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ನಡುವೆ ಸಗಟು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಇರುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ?

body.en: Internal (home) trade is the buying and selling of goods and services within the boundaries of a nation. No customs duty or import duty is levied, since goods are produced and consumed within the country. It is classified into wholesale trade, the purchase and sale in large quantities, mostly to retailers and industrial users, and retail trade, the sale in small quantities to the ultimate consumers.
body.kn: ಆಂತರಿಕ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಎಂದರೆ ದೇಶದೊಳಗಿನ ಖರೀದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಗಟು ಮತ್ತು ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಎಂಬ ಎರಡು ಭಾಗಗಳಿವೆ.

points.en: Wholesale trade: large quantities, to retailers
Retail trade: small quantities, to consumers

narration.en: Internal trade is buying and selling within a country. It has two parts: wholesale trade and retail trade.
narration.kn: ಆಂತರಿಕ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಎಂದರೆ ದೇಶದೊಳಗಿನ ಖರೀದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾರಾಟ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಗಟು ಮತ್ತು ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಎಂಬ ಎರಡು ಭಾಗಗಳಿವೆ.

title.en: On the board: Internal trade and wholesalers

narration.en: Goods travel from the producer to the consumer through middlemen. All this happens inside one country, so there is no customs duty.

say.en: Goods travel from the producer to the consumer through middlemen. All this happens inside one country, so there is no customs duty.
Internal trade is of two kinds: wholesale, buying and selling in bulk, and retail, selling small lots to consumers.
A wholesaler serves both sides. To manufacturers he gives scale, takes risk, pays early and gives advice.
To retailers he gives variety, marketing support, credit, product knowledge and shares their risk.

body.en: To manufacturers: wholesalers facilitate large-scale production by collecting small orders from many retailers; bear risk by buying in their own name and storing goods; give financial assistance by paying cash for goods and sometimes advancing money; give expert advice on customer tastes and market conditions; help in marketing; and help continuity of production by buying as goods are produced and storing them. To retailers: they ensure availability of a variety of goods, give marketing support, grant credit, offer specialised knowledge about products, and share risk by supplying in small lots.
body.kn: ಸಗಟು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳು ಬೃಹತ್ ಖರೀದಿ, ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯ ಹೊರುವ ಮೂಲಕ ತಯಾರಕರಿಗೆ, ಸಿದ್ಧ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು, ಸಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸಲಹೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.

points.en: Manufacturers: large-scale production, risk bearing, finance, advice, marketing, storage
Retailers: availability, marketing support, credit, specialised knowledge, risk sharing

narration.en: Wholesalers help manufacturers by buying in bulk, storing goods and bearing risk, and help retailers with ready stock, credit and advice.
narration.kn: ಸಗಟು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳು ಬೃಹತ್ ಖರೀದಿ, ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯ ಹೊರುವ ಮೂಲಕ ತಯಾರಕರಿಗೆ, ಸಿದ್ಧ ದಾಸ್ತಾನು, ಸಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸಲಹೆಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.

caption.en: Each middleman adds a margin. Wholesale price = factory price × (1 + w/100); retail price = wholesale price × (1 + r/100).

narration.en: Move the margins and watch the price grow at each step from the factory to the consumer.

tryThis.en: With 10% and 20% margins, is the total markup 30%? Why not?
Set the wholesaler margin to zero, as when a retailer buys direct. What does the consumer pay?
Which margin should the wholesaler cut to bring the retail price under ₹125?

problem.en: A Davangere cotton mill sells 10,000 metres of cloth to a wholesaler, who stores it and sells 200 metres each to 50 retailers on 30 days' credit. List the services the wholesaler gives the mill and the retailers.

steps.en: Check: 50 retailers × 200 m = 10,000 m, so the wholesaler sells the whole lot in small parts.
To the mill: one bulk order (large-scale production), immediate payment (financial help), storage and risk bearing.
To retailers: goods available in small lots, credit for 30 days, and sharing of the risk of holding large stocks.

answer.en: Mill: bulk buying, finance, storage, risk bearing. Retailers: availability in small lots, credit, risk sharing.

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Internal trade: within a nation, no customs duty.
Wholesale: large quantities to retailers; retail: small quantities to consumers.
points.kn: ಸಗಟು: ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ; ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ: ಗ್ರಾಹಕರಿಗೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ.

points.en: Wholesalers help manufacturers with bulk buying, finance, storage and risk.
points.kn: ಸಗಟು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳು ಬೃಹತ್ ಖರೀದಿ, ಹಣಕಾಸು, ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ತಯಾರಕರಿಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.

points.en: Wholesalers help retailers with availability, credit and advice.
points.kn: ಸಗಟು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳು ಲಭ್ಯತೆ, ಸಾಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸಲಹೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿಲ್ಲರೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಗಳಿಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.

homework.en: Ask a local shopkeeper which wholesaler supplies him and what credit he gets.

narration.en: Recap. Internal trade: within a nation, no customs duty. Wholesale: large quantities to retailers; retail: small quantities to consumers. Wholesalers help manufacturers with bulk buying, finance, storage and risk. Wholesalers help retailers with availability, credit and advice.
